purpose: Candidate source discovery for EXP-001. Metadata review only; no source has been licensed, de-duplicated, ingested, or cleared for analysis.

sources.title: Adult Genotype-Tissue Expression Project, V11
limitations: Public donor age is reported in 10-year brackets; exact donor age is protected.
Raw sequencing data and complete donor metadata require controlled access.
GTEx version releases must not be counted as independent cohorts.

sources.title: Primary human skin fibroblast aging transcriptomes
limitations: Source describes 82 people spanning ages 22–89; independently verify sample-to-donor mapping and downloadable processed matrices.
In-vitro cultured fibroblast biology is not a direct measurement of whole-organism aging.
No dataset independence or expression preprocessing has been verified.

sources.title: Human dermal fibroblasts from young and older donors
limitations: Source reports four younger (23–33) and five older (64–72) donors; small cohort and broad grouping.
Cannot treat individual sequencing replicates as independent human donors.
Cultured cells are not direct evidence of human healthspan or lifespan.

sources.title: Human epidermal keratinocyte aging, single-cell RNA-seq
limitations: Young 20–30 versus older 65–70 female donors; donor number requires verification.
Cells from one donor are not independent donors.
Not directly comparable to bulk RNA-seq without modality-aware handling.

sources.title: Human peripheral blood leukocyte aging transcriptome
limitations: Confirm publicly available age annotation, sample counts, normalized gene matrix and blood cell composition.
Potentially substantial immunological and cell-composition confounding.
No independent cohort or usage permission review completed.
